target_customer: Knowledge workers and developers who write a lot, plus enterprises; paid individual and team subscriptions
problem: Typing is slow and tiring, and earlier dictation tools were inaccurate; Aqua lets users speak into any text field with fast, context aware text.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer subscription app with developer API access
product_category: AI voice dictation and voice input

founders.name: Finnian Brown
prior_employers: A product company described as between Figma and Pinterest (per The Bridge interview)
previous_startups: Earlier product named Vienna, relaunched as Aqua Voice
founders.background_notes: Dyslexic, has used dictation since sixth grade per the YC launch bio.

founders.name: Jack McIntire
founders.background_notes: No education or employers listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Sub 100 millisecond start and fast insertion with its own speech model (Avalon) and deep context across apps is hard for a five person team.

defensibility.rationale: Several well funded dictation apps (Wispr Flow, Superwhisper) offer similar features; a proprietary speech model is the main differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platform dictation improved but the company grew in 2025 and 2026 with a relaunch, an iPhone app and an Android app in October 2026.

market_need_then: Large language models made accurate, formatted dictation possible in 2023 and 2024; Brown cites his own dyslexia and the dissatisfaction with earlier dictation tools.

branding.domain_note: Earlier site withaqua.com; current site aquavoice.com.

identity.mascot_or_character: Aqua Pet feature named on the site, not described in sources
identity.visual_style: Clean product site with testimonials from X posts
identity.voice_and_tone: Speed and polish: 'Speak into your apps', 'Frontier voice input'

branding.brand_signature: Wave emoji and 'Speak into your apps' tagline on the site

rebrands.why: Reason not stated; the post 'Vienna is now Aqua Voice' is on the company blog.

branding.community_and_virality: Website quotes user testimonials from X and the company says more than half of users are in Japan (April 2026 interview).

brand_strength.rationale: Easy name and visible user love on X and Product Hunt, growing across languages, but a generic name in a crowded category.

pivots.to: Press to talk dictation that inserts text at the cursor in any app
pivots.why: The document editor did not reach product market fit; the dictation relaunch in February to March 2025 resonated quickly per The Bridge.

outcome_analysis: Aqua Voice started as a voice document editor, failed to find fit, then relaunched in early 2025 as system wide dictation and grew quickly, especially among developers and in Japan, adding iPhone and Android apps. Funding is only thinly sourced and no exit or later round was found. The category is crowded with Wispr Flow and Superwhisper.
notes: Funding unverified: Caplight lists a seed dated 2024-03-26 and 3.25 million total with Pioneer Fund, 1517 Fund, FJ Labs and others; Simplify says 2.4 million; VCBacked says 500K pre-seed. Only aggregators, so no round recorded. The Bridge says individual investments came from Peter Thiel and Taro Fukuyama of Rice Capital, with no amounts. Competitor searches returned only 2025 and 2026 coverage, nothing dated near the 2024 batch, so the list is empty. Brown's prior employer is described only vaguely by the interview.
